# Ontario.ca

> Ontario's official government portal providing comprehensive information on social services, employment, business support, healthcare, education, and civic services for residents and businesses.

Ontario.ca is the primary digital gateway for Ontario government services, covering everything from financial assistance programs like ODSP and Ontario Works to business registration, education funding, and environmental protection. The site aggregates information across multiple ministries including Finance, Tourism, Culture and Gaming, and provides access to key programs like Better Jobs Ontario, the Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program (OINP), and the Ontario Job Bank.

## Key Topics

- Ontario Works
- Ontario Disability Support Program (ODSP)
- Ontario Trillium Benefit
- Better Jobs Ontario
- Skilled Trades Ontario
- Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program (OINP)
- Ontario Job Bank
- My Career Journey
- Health811
- OSAP
- Outdoors Card
- Tax credits and benefits
- Crown land
- First Nations
- Northern Ontario

## Government Services & Information

- [Government](https://www.ontario.ca/page/government): Ontario government services, transparency and ministry directory

## Financial Assistance & Benefits

- [Benefits and taxes](https://www.ontario.ca/page/benefits-and-taxes): Ontario tax credits and financial assistance programs including ODSP and Ontario Works
- [Family and social services](https://www.ontario.ca/page/family-and-social-services): Ontario family support, ODSP, Ontario Works and government benefits
- [Home and housing](https://www.ontario.ca/page/home-and-housing): Ontario housing programs, tenant rights and affordable housing

## Employment, Business & Economy

- [Jobs and employment](https://www.ontario.ca/page/jobs-and-employment): Ontario job search, Ontario Job Bank and employment resources
- [Business, workplace and economy](https://www.ontario.ca/page/business-and-economy): Business registration, funding, tax credits and startup support in Ontario
- [Rural, agriculture and north](https://www.ontario.ca/page/rural-agriculture-and-north): Northern Ontario, agriculture funding and rural development support

## Education & Skills Development

- [Education and apprenticeships](https://www.ontario.ca/page/education-and-apprenticeships): Ontario education, training, OSAP financial aid and apprenticeships

## Health, Justice & Legal Services

- [Your health](https://www.ontario.ca/page/your-health): Ontario healthcare services, Health811 and patient care access
- [Courts, justice and law](https://www.ontario.ca/page/courts-justice-and-law): Ontario legal system, courts, OPP, emergency services and victim support

## Immigration, Environment & Recreation

- [Immigrate to Ontario](https://www.ontario.ca/page/immigrate-to-ontario): Ontario immigration pathways, OINP program and settlement support
- [Environment and energy](https://www.ontario.ca/page/environment-and-energy): Ontario wildlife conservation, energy, Great Lakes protection and environment
- [Recreation and tourism](https://www.ontario.ca/page/recreation-and-tourism): Ontario parks, hunting, fishing, tourism and outdoor recreation

## Optional

- [Heritage, arts and history](https://www.ontario.ca/page/heritage-arts-and-history): Ontario cultural institutions, arts grants and heritage resources
- [Land use planning](https://www.ontario.ca/page/land-use-planning): Ontario land use planning, zoning policies and development guidance
